turns.reply: The fix is in `Style.clear_meta_and_links` in `rich/style.py`: it now sets the new style's `_hash` to `None` instead of copying the old cached hash, so the hash is recomputed without the cleared link and meta. A quick check confirmed the cleared style hashes equal to a plain style with the same attributes, and `tests/test_style.py` passes (26 tests). I did not add a regression test to the suite, since test files were off-limits in this session.
